# contextforai

> One API that turns any URL into clean Markdown, HTML, JSON, a sitemap, fonts, a screenshot, or brand assets. Pay in credits (5 per call, 10 for screenshot and branding). 500 free credits to start.

## Docs
- [API reference](https://contextforai.ashutoshswamy.in/docs): authentication, endpoints, schemas, rate limits, error codes
